ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000

input.comment: [Playbook] Because Fees is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, this cap is illusory rather than the 12 months of fees our playbook requires; we have keyed it to all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the preceding 12 months, with a USD 1,000,000 floor. Indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud remain outside the cap as Excluded Claims.
input.summary: Replace illusory implementation-fee cap with greater of 12 months of amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and USD 1,000,000.
